metaTitle: Stop Threats at the Gate | SecuEdge
metaDescription: Intrusion prevention, gateway antivirus, threat intelligence and web filtering block attacks before they reach your devices.

hero.headline: Stop threats at the gate.
hero.sub: Intrusion prevention, gateway antivirus, threat intelligence and web filtering block attacks before they reach your devices.

challenges.title: Ordinary traffic carries attacks
challenges.desc: Malware, phishing and ransomware reach a network through ordinary traffic: a link, a download, a call home to an attacker's server. A firewall that only checks addresses misses what is inside.

challenges.title: Links and downloads
challenges.desc: Everyday work — a link, a download — is how malware arrives.

challenges.title: Inside matters
challenges.desc: Checking addresses alone misses what traffic carries.

approach.title: Deep packet inspection
approach.desc: Checks what is inside the traffic, not just where it is going.

approach.title: Intrusion prevention
approach.desc: Spots and blocks attacks as they happen.

approach.title: Gateway antivirus
approach.desc: Catches infected files before they reach a computer.

approach.title: Threat intelligence and IP reputation
approach.desc: Blocks known-bad sources, including ransomware command servers.

indiaContext: Threat data is applied on the appliance in India; your traffic is not routed overseas for inspection.

process.title: Identify
process.desc: We learn how your network is used: how many people, which sites, which systems matter most.

process.title: Analyze
process.desc: We recommend the right model and settings for your risks and your industry.

process.title: Protect
process.desc: Our team or partner sets up SecuEdge Frontier and trains your team.

process.title: Adapt
process.desc: Regular updates, quarterly security reviews and 24/7 India-based support keep you protected as things change.

faqs.a: SecuEdge Frontier receives regular threat updates as part of your subscription.
Each model is sized for its number of users so protection stays on. Our team will size it with you.

faqs.q: What happens when something is blocked?
faqs.a: It is logged with the time, device and reason, and shown on your dashboard.
In India, by default. Traffic, logs and policy data stay on Indian soil, with no overseas routing.
24/7 technical support from India-based engineers on 1800 123 0966. We respond within 24 hours.
